slots.name: API China share
slots.sentence: But in aggregate, probably no more than a quarter of drug units currently sold in the U.S. have API fully manufactured in China.

slots.name: Statin users
slots.sentence: with perhaps as many as 90 million Americans taking them, a major shortage would become a significant disruption to care for many, likely with political repercussions.

slots.name: U.S. drugs count
slots.sentence: But how does one overcome the Chinese cost advantage for the over 2,000 different drugs sold in the U.S.?

slots.name: shortage-free years
slots.sentence: Although no drug shortages in the last 20 years appear to have been caused by export restrictions, COVID-19 created some close calls, reminding policymakers across the globe that geopolitics could lead to supply disruptions, potentially affecting a much broader set of drugs than the ones that have historically experienced shortages.

slots.name: essential medicines list date
slots.sentence: The idea of prioritizing drug supply chains to support only select ones is not new: the Trump administration directed FDA in 2020 to develop a list of essential medicines needed to address pandemics as well as threats involving chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear hazards.
